label: managerial or organizational leader of
definition: Person X holds a managerial or organizational leadership office in organization Y.
scope_notes: Director and head paths dominate, preserving the prior broad managerial scope for director clusters. Departmental or research directorship qualifies; economist, lobbyist and academic roles alone do not. Inverse organization-to-president paths are separate.

facts.reason: Philippe de Montebello is explicitly director of the Met in repeated office descriptions.
Stephen S. Roach is described only as Morgan Stanley economist, without a managerial office in this case.
Kevin McKenzie is explicitly director of Ballet Theater; principal is an additional role description.
John Rother is explicitly director, including director of legislation, for the American Association of Retired Persons; lobbying is an additional role.
Raymond D. Horton is explicitly director, head and president of the Citizens Budget Commission; professor and inverse-looking paths are additional evidence.
